label: 0030 · Smoothed in time, 1997–2025 (one QP over all windows of 0024): 0028 with smoother Tohoku afterslip kept down dip of the trench edge, correlated noise, fixed 747-site network, UNR positions (MAP)
description: 0028 with 0029's smoother, down-dip Tohoku afterslip state (150 km length scale instead of 64 km; prior cut to 20% shallower than 5 km, full below 20 km). 25% of the first-year afterslip moment is now shallower than 15 km (0028: 52%), and the short-wavelength patches near the trench are gone. Tohoku afterslip is Mw 8.25 at 1 yr, 8.31 at 2 yr and 8.38 at 5 yr (0028: 8.36, 8.42, 8.50). The fit after Tohoku is 2.2% worse (median), and 16% worse from September 2011 to March 2012. The length scale and taper depths were chosen by eye, not cross-validated. MAP solution, no posterior SD.
